
---

**Download** `ClassroomToolkit-${VERSION}.zip` below, extract it and run `ClassroomToolkit.exe`. If an older version is running, right-click its icon by the clock and choose **Exit** first. Your lists and settings carry over.

**Requirements:** Windows 10 version 1809 (LTSC 2019) or later, or Windows 11. It uses the .NET Framework already built into Windows, so there is nothing else to install.

Windows may say the file is from an unknown publisher, because it isn't code-signed. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/LukeHarrison1990/classroom-tools/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
